queries.query: Optimize the production API so its p95 latency drops from 300 ms to 150 ms without changing the response.

The service retains steadily more memory after each batch. Diagnose transient allocation versus reachable retention and propose a measured fix.
Fix the CI test that intermittently fails with EADDRINUSE when jobs run in parallel.
Every test rebuilds the same expensive fixture. Redesign the test suite so it runs less duplicated setup.
Raise unit-test coverage from 80 to 90 percent by covering the remaining branches.
